artworks.title: Lazell, Perkins & Co., Bridgewater, Mass.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1961)
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene around Lazell, Perkins & Co. in Bridgewater, Massachusetts. Various buildings including factories, houses, and a church with a steeple are arranged along the horizon. The illustration depicts a bustling industrial area with a train in the foreground, billowing smoke, and pathways and fences. The color palette includes earthy tones with black smoke rising into the sky.

artworks.title: Study for "Dance on the Battery in Presence of Peter Stuyvesant"
artworks.medium: charcoal with brown and white chalk on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mary Bartlett Cowdrey, 1948)
artworks.description: This painting captures a scene with a group of figures engaged in various activities such as dancing, playing instruments, and sitting. The figures are arranged in a circular composition with dark shading creating a sense of movement. The color palette is predominantly blue and grey, giving the scene a dreamlike quality. The forms are a mix of defined and indistinct, emphasizing the vibrancy and rhythm of the event. The style is similar to Rembrandt, known for his use of light and shadow and dynamic group compositions.

artworks.title: The Great Blizzard of 1899
artworks.medium: gouache with watercolor and charcoal on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of the artist, 1909)
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene during winter with snow covering the landscape. The perspective is street level, capturing two buildings partially, one on the left with architectural details and snow-covered branches in front, and a tall building on the right with elaborate rooftop and façade covered in snow. The horizon aligns with the roofs of the buildings and the trees. The falling snow and accumulation are depicted with swirling, soft brushstrokes. The color palette includes whites, grays, and muted browns. Snow blurs the lower part of the view where small dark figures and carriages suggest movement against the snowy scene.

artworks.title: Plan of the Siege of Savannah
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a map detailing the Siege of Savannah. The drawing displays a plan view of the military positions and geographical layout surrounding the Savannah River during the time of the siege. The map outlines various parts of the terrain, including wooded areas, elevation changes, and the river. It is labeled with annotations marking the positions of key elements such as batteries, forts, encampments, and notable geographic features. The lines and shading techniques illustrate the landscape and the fortifications in a detailed manner, giving viewers a view of the situation during this historical event.

artworks.title: Man Pulling a Horse into a Stall
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of three men and a horse. On the left, a man in a hat stands behind the horse, leading it forward. The horse is in a dynamic walking stance. In the center, another man is in front of the horse, pulling on a rope attached to its bridle. On the right, a third man holds a long object and appears to be giving instructions. The men's faces are not detailed. The sketch is done in pencil with shading for depth. The background shows minimal details of an indoor environment.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a collection of pencil sketches showing multiple views of soldiers and their features. The sketches do not capture full bodies; rather, they focus on either heads or partial figures. Several drawings portray the subjects as lying down, with different angles showing them in a side-lying position. The faces of these individuals are detailed, showing varied expressions, some with their eyes closed. The hair of each person is depicted with varying lengths, with several sketches featuring close-cropped styles. Clothing is not prominently featured except for a depiction of a uniform jacket and a military helmet in some sketches. A few of the figures have blindfolds. The background of the sketch is plain, with no additional objects or scenery, allowing emphasis on the depicted figures.

artworks.title: Study for "The Danaïdes"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Study for "Dogma of the Redemption: Frieze of Angels" [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing. The person is facing forward with their face slightly tilted upwards and their eyes looking forward. Their facial features include outlined eyes, a straight nose, and lips, with short hair. The person is wearing a long robe with draped fabric and shading for texture. They are holding a hammer-like object in their right hand and a goblet or cup in their left hand. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features three military figures sketched in detail on the left side. The figures are standing close together and facing slightly left. The leftmost figure wears a soldier's hat and is holding the central figure, who wears a long coat and an officer's hat. The central figure, wearing a helmet and holding a rifle, supports the leftmost figure and has their right hand on the third figure on their right. Detailed hand sketches occupy the right side of the image. The drawing is done in charcoal or pencil on a plain background.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed" [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal with graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals lying on the ground in a reclining pose, with their limbs somewhat entangled. They are both wearing military uniforms and hats. Ropes or cables are visible around them. The background is plain, with no detailed scenery or objects.

artworks.title: Mery Horn, a hunchback condition aggravated by the heavy load of papers she carried. Hartford, Connecticut, March 1909
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Harry H. Lunn, Jr., through Graphics International Ltd., 1977)
artworks.description: The image features a young girl from the head to about the knees, standing in front of a brick wall. She has her hands in the pockets of her coat, with a neutral expression, long hair partially covered by a dark hat or hood, styled with large bows. The girl is wearing a dark, long coat with the collar up. A wooden door is slightly visible in the background, and an arm of a person is seen wearing a similar coat, indicating a cold environment.

artworks.title: Bookplate for Calvin Coolidge
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole, after Sidney Lawton Smith
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a highly detailed illustration with a central oval frame depicting a scenic landscape. The view appears elevated, looking down on a grassy area with a tree nearby, and a pathway leading to a house in the distance. The horizon is suggested by trees beyond the house and the cloudy sky above. The engraving features intricate lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, using various shades of black and grey. Above the landscape is a portrait of a historical figure against an American flag, with the name "Calvin Coolidge" below, surrounded by decorative engravings.

artworks.title: Mr. Cunin Grid...(Cunin-Gridaine)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright with his hands in his pockets. He has distinct facial features, oval-shaped eyeglasses, and thick wavy hair styled away from his face. He is dressed in a dark tailcoat with lapels, a light waistcoat, and shimmering light trousers. The man wears dark, polished shoes and there is no visible jewelry. The background is plain with only the man's shadow on the ground, emphasizing his appearance.

artworks.title: Sire! Lisbonne est prise... (Sire! Lisbon has been captured...)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures standing waist up. One figure is on the left side and the other on the right side. The person on the left is in a military stance with distinct attire, including a tall helmet with a plume, epaulettes, and medals. Their face has a caricatured appearance, with a prominent nose. They wear dark clothing with light gloves and boots and have a sword by their side. The person on the right is in a loose nightshirt, yawning with eyes partially closed and stretching one arm up while scratching their head with the other hand. They have short, slightly messy hair and sideburns. A bay-like object is partially visible near the person on the right, suggesting a piece of furniture. The background is plain, emphasizing the two foreground figures.

artworks.title: Landscape with Three Trees
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1959)
artworks.description: The image features a landscape view sketched with delicate pencil strokes, showcasing a natural setting. The depiction includes a small body of water with grasses along the banks, distant trees forming a horizon, and three central trees with distinct shapes. The artwork demonstrates meticulous brushwork, fine lines for textures, and depth through shading. The monochromatic palette conveys a serene ambiance.

artworks.title: La Mère Gérard
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1928)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a relaxed pose looking straight ahead. The person is wearing historical attire, including a long dress, a shawl, and a bonnet. They are holding a piece of fabric on their right arm. The background is plain with a simple, lightly sketched texture.

artworks.title: Parlons, Madame...ces nudités sont révoltantes...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art gallery scene. The image shows several individuals in the gallery, with a painting or print of abstract figures above them. The drawing style uses strong, sharp black lines to outline the expressions and attire of the individuals. One person wears a top hat and looks concerned, while others seem absorbed in the artworks. The composition highlights the contrasting reactions between the subjects and the art. The text at the bottom gives a humorous or satirical message about the art. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century caricature or satirical illustrations.

artworks.title: La voyez-vous la comète? ... La-haut ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men shown in full body. The man on the left is pointing upwards with his right arm while slightly leaning forward. He is wearing a coat that reaches below his knees and a flat cap. His facial features include a broad nose and he has a short beard or stubble. The man on the right is standing upright, holding an umbrella under his left arm. He is wearing a top hat and a long, striped coat that drapes past his knees. His facial features include a prominent nose and sideburns. The men's clothing appears to be from the 19th century, and the scene is a monochromatic illustration. In the background, there's a cityscape with buildings and a starry night sky.

artworks.title: Une erreur excuable
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman sitting closely together. The man has a tall hat, a narrow face, a prominent nose, and short hair. The woman wears a bonnet tied under her chin and a long, voluminous dress. Several chickens are around them. The background shows lightly sketched trees on the right and a building or wall on the left.

artworks.title: Entre recors
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted from the waist up. The man on the left faces slightly to the side with arms crossed, while the man on the right has his back to the viewer and is turned slightly to the left. The man on the left has a stern expression with a prominent chin, wearing a tall top hat covering dark hair. The other man has a wrinkled facial profile and wears a hat that fits closely to his head. The man on the left is dressed in a dark coat and a patterned scarf, and the man on the right wears a lighter shirt. Both hold long sticks in each hand. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with a thin black border. Printed text below the figures indicates dialogue or a caption related to the scene.

artworks.title: Meditation
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait focusing on a person's upper body with an emphasis on their face and hand. The individual is shown with their head slightly tilted and supported by their hand under the chin. The facial features are softly defined with shaded areas, suggesting a serene expression. The person's dark hair blends into a shadowy background lacking specific details. The focus remains on the face and hand, which dominate the composition. There is no visible jewelry on the person, and the background has a smoky, gradient-like texture.

artworks.title: Scène d'audience (les deux avocats) (Scene of a Hearing (The Two Lawyers))
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch showing partial bodies of three figures seated closely together. The figures have elongated and stylized faces with basic outlines reminiscent of early 20th-century fashion. Two of the figures wear headwear, and one figure on the left wears a suit. The background is filled with heavy, textured, diagonal pencil marks. In the top right corner, there is a separate, smaller drawing of a single face with detailed features, wearing a hat and looking forward.

artworks.title: Une mission délicate
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an encounter between a man in uniform and a dog. The scene takes place on a cobblestone street in front of a wall plastered with notices, one of which bears the words "ORDONNANCE CONCERNANT LES CHIENS." The central figure holds a net and basket, and opposite him stands a sturdy dog. The drawing uses shading and line work to add depth and texture. The expressions of the man and dog are exaggerated, typical of caricature art.

artworks.title: Le Petit Thiers, Baptisé Doctrinaire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene inside a church. The image shows a baptism with a comedic style. In the center, a clergyman is performing the baptism on a baby, while an elderly woman holds the baby. Two men are observing on the left. The baptismal font is ornate, featuring a large bowl on a pedestal. The drawing has exaggerated features and facial expressions, giving it a satirical tone.
